_comment: Single source of truth for the water model. water_model.py reads this file too, so editing it here changes the CLI as well.

water._source: Implied by Google's 2025 disclosure that a median Gemini text prompt uses 0.24 Wh and 0.26 mL. Covers on-site cooling plus the water used generating the electricity.

claude_tokens_wh._source: Generating a token is one forward pass and uses the hardware poorly. Prefill runs the prompt through in parallel, roughly ten times cheaper per token; the variants are scaled by their billing ratios (cache write 1.25x input, cache read 0.1x).

weavy.label: Weavy
weavy._source: Anchored on Luccioni et al. (2024), which measured ~2.9 Wh for a single image from the largest generation models tested. At Weavy's 9 credits per image that is ~0.32 Wh per credit, and credits then price every other operation for free.

gemini-pro.label: Gemini Pro
gemini-pro._source: Google puts a median Gemini text prompt at 0.24 Wh. Pro is the larger model and usually reasons before answering, so this defaults to roughly four times the median. A rough default -- change it in Assumptions.

comparisons.label: a day of average household water use
